articles.title: Historian blasts Smithsonian's activism shift after first visit in over a decade: 'Completely different place' - Fox News
articles.description: Dr. Jody Edward Ginn says the Smithsonian National Museum of American History abandoned education for activism after visiting for the first time since 2012.
